We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. Customer expansion is one of Vanta's highest-priority growth levers, and this role sits at the center of it. As the Revenue Enablement Manager supporting Account Management, you'll operate as a strategic thought partner to AM leadership and the broader Revenue organization — designing and leading the programs that make Account Managers more effective, equip them to drive expansion, and help them operate as a unified front with the Account Executive team. This is a high-autonomy role that connects data, business priorities, and cross-functional expertise to directly influence AM performance and expansion outcomes, and you'll be the architect of a consistent, repeatable expansion motion that defines how Vanta shows up across the full customer lifecycle. What you’ll do as a Revenue Enablement Manager at Vanta: - Serve as a strategic partner to the Head of Global Account Management and AM leaders, building a deep understanding of the global AM business and proactively identifying where enablement can drive measurable impact. - Independently identify performance trends, capability gaps, and organizational priorities by combining data analysis with field insights and stakeholder input, conducting ongoing needs assessments with AM and AE leadership to surface whitespace opportunities and prioritize enablement investments. - Shape and maintain the AM enablement strategy and roadmap — including playbooks, skill-based training, and certifications — in alignment with the broader Revenue organization's priorities, accelerating account growth and improving net revenue retention (NRR). - Design, launch, and measure strategic enablement programs that improve Account Manager performance and increase pipeline generation for expansion. - Build programs that establish a consistent, cohesive sales motion between Account Executives and Account Managers, ensuring a seamless, high-quality customer experience from new logo through expansion. - Drive adoption of sales processes and reinforce consistent execution across the global AM organization. - Partner with Product Enablement, Product Marketing, and GTM Enablement peers to ensure AMs have current messaging, competitive intelligence, and product knowledge that supports customer growth conversations. - Lead cross-functional initiatives from opportunity identification through program design, stakeholder alignment, execution, and measurement. - Deliver relevant, high-impact AM enablement sessions, including launching initial programs within the first 90 days. - Influence the broader enablement strategy by surfacing trends, gaps, and opportunities that help Vanta make smarter decisions across the Revenue organization. - Establish KPIs and measurement frameworks to track enablement effectiveness, reporting on both leading and lagging indicators to continuously iterate and improve program impact and adoption. - Use AI and technology to improve the effectiveness, reach, and scalability of enablement programs. axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.title: Investment Management Counsel
axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: Join Our Team as an Attorney at Axiom We are seeking an Investment & Wealth Management Counsel to join our Financial Services team . In this role, you will provide expert legal advice and support to our clients on investment advisory, fiduciary obligations, and wealth management matters, helping ensure regulatory compliance and mitigate risk. Responsibilities: Draft, review, and negotiate investment advisory agreements, trust agreements, and related wealth management documentation . Provide legal guidance on fiduciary duties and standards of care , including compliance with SEC and FINRA regulations . Advise clients on asset allocation and portfolio diversification strategies in the context of wealth management and investment advisory services. Support clients with regulatory compliance under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 and other applicable securities regulations. Assist in the development and implementation of tailored wealth strategies and conduct fiduciary reviews for investment and advisory programs. Collaborate with internal legal, compliance, and financial teams, as well as external advisors, trustees, and portfolio managers. Provide counsel on investment structures, including unregistered funds and private investment vehicles . Manage fiduciary, compliance, and investment-related legal matters for clients in the financial services, private wealth, and credit sectors . Monitor industry developments and regulatory updates impacting investment advisors, fiduciaries, and wealth managers to provide proactive guidance. Qualifications: 6+ years of experience advising on investment advisory, wealth management, or fiduciary compliance matters. Strong understanding of fiduciary duties and standards of care , including compliance with SEC and FINRA regulations . Experience advising clients on asset allocation, portfolio diversification strategies, and wealth management matters . Demonstrated experience drafting investment advisory agreements and trust agreements . Knowledge of the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 and related regulatory frameworks . Experience working with unregistered funds or private investment vehicles. Juris Doctor (JD) and licensed to practice law in an applicable jurisdiction. Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and technology skills. Preferred Skills: Experience with private wealth, private credit, or alternative investment strategies . Background advising on complex trust structuring and tailored wealth strategies . Experience conducting fiduciary reviews and regulatory risk assessments . Familiarity with institutional investment advisory, pension funds, or ERISA-related matters . Compensation: The estimated total compensation for full-time Axiom attorney roles is $104,500-325,000 per year and for non-attorney roles is $71,250-309,750 per year. Compensation decisions are based on various factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, certifications, location, and business needs. Employees may be eligible for additional benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance; paid holidays and PTO; flexible work arrangements; and professional development opportunities and tools. About Axiom: For over 25 years, Axiom has pioneered the alternative legal services industry, now serving more than 1,500 legal departments globally with our unique blend of world-class legal talent and advanced AI tools, delivering innovative solutions ranging from that combine top-tier talent with cutting-edge technology. We tackle complex legal matters across 12 practice areas for clients ranging from Fortune 100 to SMBs, empowering our legal professionals to engage in meaningful work that advances their careers. Our Talent NPS score of +71% and our Client NPS score of +64% highlight our commitment to excellence ( Reported scores were Axiom’s average for 2025 – the legal industry average NPS score is +35% ). Join our forward-thinking community where you’ll keep your career dynamic and multi-face

cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:52f67f50-dc18-46.description: ABOUT OFS: Established in 1994, OFS is a registered investment adviser providing capital and leveraged finance solutions to U.S. corporations on behalf of its advisory clients. For more than 25-years, OFS has developed a disciplined approach to provide reliable, innovative, and flexible credit solutions to U.S.-based businesses that are underserved by traditional lenders. OFS provides flexible debt financing to support recapitalizations, leveraged buyouts, and growth capital. OFS is an affiliate of CIM Group. Join us and make an impact today!
responsibilities: Monitor respective investments in the Business Services sector within the leveraged loan market.

Present written analysis on individual credits including but not limited to; identification of strengths/weaknesses, mitigants to weaknesses, business outlook, industry dynamics, company management, deal sponsor, capital structure, key credit agreement terms, collateral profile, cash flow projections/sensitivity analysis, comparable analysis, and relative value.

CPA, CFA and/or MBA a plus.

Demonstrated competence with respect to overall macro factors and subsector trends/allocations.
Demonstrated competence with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint.
Demonstrated competence/curiosity with Artificial Intelligence (CoPilot, Claude, GPT, etc).
Demonstrated competence in use of Bloomberg, Capital IQ.
Demonstrated competence with Moody’s/S&P online platforms for ratings/industry analysis.
Ability to learn/adapt to technological platforms OFS employs on proprietary basis.

coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:4880bce9-2.description: Be Part of Our Next Chapter For over almost 60 years, our solutions have enabled impactful connections between some of the world’s leading brands and their customers. And while we’ve already done a lot of work we’re proud of, we’re just getting started! We’re a global technology company focused on creating dynamic, smart, personalised and engaging customer experiences powered by our range of digital hardware, our proprietary content management system and our industry leading signage solutions. (For example: If you’ve ordered in-store or in the drive-thru at McDonald’s somewhere in the world in the last few years, chances are you’ve interacted with our digital solutions.) We work in over 50 global markets and have 9 offices around the world, with a global headquarters proudly located in our founding home of Sydney, Australia. Coates Group has the values of a family-owned business and the innovative spirit of a start-up, both which fuel our purpose – Creating Connections. Empowering Partnerships. Always Evolving. Through hard work, dedication and creativity, we’ve become industry leaders who have won awards and set records while remaining focused on continual growth and evolution. We are a 2x Australia Good Design Award winner and successfully completed the largest hardware deployment in Quick Service Restaurant history. We are curious, charismatic, authentic and we value and leverage the diversity of our crew. We are imaginers, kindness enthusiasts, experts, creators, thinkers, challengers, collaborators and over-achievers. And together, as a Crew, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s leading brands leverage technology to drive the best customer experiences. We’re looking for a Program Manager to turn strategy into execution, leading the programs that drive outcomes across our products, solutions, and client initiatives. You’ll build the structure and rhythm behind our most important work, ensuring programs are delivered on time, aligned to client expectations, and supporting Coates’ commercial goals. Working closely with product, technology, delivery, and commercial teams, you’ll bring clarity to complex initiatives and keep stakeholders aligned. Along the way, you’ll use data, insights, and smart processes to improve how we operate, driving efficiency, visibility, and better outcomes for our teams, partners, and clients.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:163bbb92-1911-.title: Product Design Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:163bbb92-1911-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Design Engineer based in France. As a Product Design Engineer, you’ll combine product design and front-end engineering to take ideas from early exploration through to production. You’ll shape what is worth building, prototype rapidly, and personally turn strong concepts into polished digital experiences. Working within a product squad, you’ll partner closely with software engineers while owning the experience and interface layer. A major focus will be designing human-centred experiences for AI-native products, where users supervise, review, correct, and authorise work performed by intelligent agents. You’ll have substantial influence over product decisions rather than simply executing finished specifications. This is an ideal role for a multidisciplinary builder who values speed, craft, product judgment, and the ability to ship. Explore product opportunities through user research, experimentation, prototyping, and iterative design to identify the strongest solutions. Carry product concepts through to production-ready front-end experiences, combining design decisions and implementation within the same workflow. Help define what is worth building by engaging with users, challenging assumptions, validating problems, and shaping scope with the product squad. Design and build intuitive supervisory interfaces for AI-native workflows, including triage queues, confidence and citation patterns, briefings, and other decision-support experiences. Use AI tools throughout the product development lifecycle, including research, design, prototyping, development, and testing. Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically, applying strong product and design judgment rather than relying on automated results without review. Collaborate closely with software engineers responsible for the underlying systems and ensure the final experience works effectively with the technical architecture. Take ownership of front-end quality, including performance, accessibility, responsive behaviour, cross-device compatibility, and perceived speed. Continuously iterate on products based on user feedback, technical constraints, and real-world usage. Deliver polished, production-ready experiences that balance usability, functionality, technical feasibility, and visual quality. Requirements: Proven experience designing and building front-end products through to production, with ownership of both the experience and implementation. Strong design judgment and visual/product taste, with the ability to distinguish genuinely excellent experiences from interfaces that are merely functional. Strong product instinct and the ability to challenge assumptions, reduce unnecessary scope, and validate ideas with real users. Fluency in modern web development and front-end engineering practices. Demonstrated experience using AI tooling across multiple stages of product development, including research, design, prototyping, coding, and testing. Strong understanding of AI limitations and failure modes, with the ability to identify when AI-generated output appears correct but is not. Experience creating data-rich, complex, or high-stakes interfaces for demanding professional users. Ability to communicate credibly with domain experts and translate complex workflows into clear, effective product experiences. Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, performance, and cross-device behaviour. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary product squad alongside software engineers and other stakeholders. Candidates may come from design, engineering, or multidisciplinary backgrounds; the key requirement is the ability to design, build, and ship high-quality products. Benefits: Fully remote working opportunity within the UK or Europe. Opportunity to combine product design and front-end engineering without traditional handoffs between design and

jobgether-jobgether:lever:41b26cf4-bf9b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in Ireland. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b61cc1cd-6225-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. This is a senior leadership opportunity to build and lead a modern Finance function within a fast-growing international payments environment. You will own management reporting, financial control, budgeting, settlements, cash-flow planning, and financial process optimization. The role combines strategic leadership with hands-on ownership of financial models, reporting logic, reconciliations, and operational controls. You will partner closely with Data, Development, Treasury, and executive leadership to turn complex financial information into actionable business insights. A key focus will be replacing manual processes with reliable, automated reporting and scalable financial workflows. You will also oversee financial operations across multiple legal entities, currencies, products, merchants, and payment methods. Establish clear operating boundaries between Finance, Treasury, and Data while maintaining effective collaboration across these functions. Develop a scalable Finance function capable of supporting growth across multiple markets, entities, currencies, and transaction volumes. Professional background in fintech, payments/PSP, acquiring, EMI, banking, crypto payments, or another high-volume transactional business. Proven experience building or transforming financial processes, particularly moving from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated data pipelines and reporting. Strong experience managing multiple legal entities, currencies, and intercompany operations. Hands-on ownership of P&L, Cash Flow, Balance Sheet, plan-vs-actual reporting, and financial forecasting. Ability to define financial metrics, establish standardized calculation methodologies, and develop unit economics and profitability analysis by product, customer, channel, or business line. jobgether-jobgether:lever:f9eedb83-c7fe-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. The position serves as a central coordination point between field personnel, leadership, IT, operations, and external partners. You will manage multiple onboarding activities simultaneously while maintaining accurate records, timelines, and stakeholder communication. The role also offers opportunities to improve processes, strengthen operational consistency, and create a more efficient onboarding experience nationwide. Success requires strong organization, follow-through, communication, and the ability to navigate multiple systems and priorities. Manage and execute end-to-end onboarding activities for field service new hires across the United States, ensuring each employee is fully prepared and operational from their first day. Coordinate onboarding logistics and act as a central point of contact for field personnel, leadership, internal departments, and external partners. Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we want? We seek a skilled supervisor to drive results. This individual will need to be the gold standard in all our processes, so attention to detail and high drive to win is a must. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You will manage a team of highly trained, optimistic Advisors, Operators, and Attendants to provide exceptional guest service in a fun, interactive atmosphere.
